title: RFC 3977: ArticleRef::Cid unhandled in Head/Body/Stat pre-dispatch routing
description: In lifecycle.rs run_command_loop, the pre-dispatch match handles Article(Some(ArticleRef::Number)), Article(Some(ArticleRef::MessageId)), and Article(None) but does NOT match Article(Some(ArticleRef::Cid)). The Cid variant falls through to dispatch(), which hits the catch-all and returns 430 instead of a semantically correct response. Same gap exists for Head(Some(ArticleRef::Cid)) and Stat(Some(ArticleRef::Cid)). Add Cid arms to the pre-dispatch match or ensure dispatch() routes them with a correct response code.
